title: Ookiku Furikabutte: Kihon no Kihon
justification: AniList 3887 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2008-02-27) is AniDB 4923's special(s) S1, aired 2008-02-27. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 2159, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 4923, and the special's title (The Basics of Basics / Kihon no Kihon!) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/4923.json patches it, places S1 on TVDB 0x1 Basics of the Basics!, 2008-02-27. TMDB 45532, where the parent's node places the special(s), agrees: S0E1 2008-02-27.
